query: We are drafting the intent for offline sign-in. Whether the chosen identity SDK supports token refresh without a network could overturn the design. Establish what evidence we need before committing.
Our spec assumes Python 3.13 can load this native extension. The vendor support table is missing. Investigate compatibility before we approve that runtime.
The implementation plan relies on a browser API working in Safari. We have only seen Chrome behavior; resolve that uncertainty before scheduling work.
Build keeps failing at the same cross-compilation step. Before we attempt another fix, investigate whether our dependency even supports the target architecture.
Two sources disagree about whether the database driver retries non-idempotent writes. That changes the data-loss risk in our proposed design. Resolve the conflict.
Loom intent 還沒確認：我們假設套件可在沒有 Node 的使用者環境載入。請查證這個前提，因為不成立就得換方案。
正在寫 spec。舊文件說 webhook 保證順序，新文件只保證至少一次，這會改變去重設計，先解開矛盾。
規劃資料庫升級前，請確認目前版號能不能直接升到目標版；不支援就要安排中繼升級。
build 已在權限設定上失敗好幾輪；先研究 macOS sandbox 是否容許這項操作，再決定怎麼修。
這個儲存方案是否可行，取決於服務端能不能做原子條件寫入。現在沒有可靠證據，請先調查。
Loom の intent を詰めています。選定 SDK のライセンスが再配布を許すか不明で、採用可否が変わります。根拠を確認してください。
spec の前提である HTTP クライアントのプロキシ対応が現行版にもあるか、確かな資料で確認してから設計を進めたいです。
計画に入る前に、このキャッシュが複数プロセスで安全に使えるか確認したいです。仕様の説明が食い違い、方式の選択に影響します。
ビルド中、同じ ABI エラーが続きます。対応バージョンの組合せそのものが間違っていないか調べてください。
The intent compares local versus hosted parsing. We have no measured latency under the deployment constraints; determine what evidence would justify either choice.
A benchmark claims the new dependency is faster, but it used different hardware. Before changing our plan, assess whether that evidence supports the migration decision.
Our design depends on the current API retaining deleted records for thirty days. Verify that capability and identify what remains unknown before we lock the spec.
We are deciding whether to migrate authentication providers. Check whether the required passkey flow exists at the versions we can deploy; do not implement the migration.
One test says the plugin loader handles ESM, another says it only accepts CommonJS. Build is blocked until we resolve which claim applies to our supported host.
Repeated attempts to enable streaming have failed. Before another retry, establish whether our account tier and API version support it at all.
Critique the value and complexity of adding a dashboard export button. Technical feasibility is settled; focus on whether this product idea earns its maintenance cost.
Get an independent coding-agent opinion on our architecture trade-off. The evidence is collected already; I want a second reviewer, not another investigation.
Review this development session for process improvements: we skipped the kickoff, implemented the agreed tiny change, and ran tests late. No technical issue remains open.
The intent and feasibility are approved. Turn the agreed addition of a keyboard shortcut into implementation tasks with acceptance checks.
I want an undo button for deleted drafts. Help capture the user problem, intended outcome and acceptance criteria; there is no known engineering uncertainty yet.
